readings: start_shifting is asserted in the same cycle that the final 1 of 1101 is sampled (combinational/Mealy output).
start_shifting is asserted one clock cycle later, after the FSM registers the final bit (registered/Moore output).
Reset clears both the sequence-detection state and start_shifting, so the FSM restarts from the initial state and start_shifting goes to 0.
Reset only clears start_shifting while leaving the sequence-detection state unchanged, so the FSM can continue a partial match across reset.
start_shifting is gated by reset, so it is forced to 0 whenever reset is high, regardless of the current state and input.

start_shifting is not gated by reset; since reset is synchronous, it only affects the state at the clock edge, so start_shifting can still be 1 during a cycle where reset is high if the sequence condition is met.
Before reset is asserted, start_shifting is 0 and the FSM is in the idle state (e.g., due to initial values).
Before reset is asserted, start_shifting and the FSM state are undefined and may take any value.
